latest_release.name: GestaltX v1.1.1
latest_release.body:
English | [简体中文](https://github.com/huamidev/GestaltX/blob/main/CHANGELOG_ZH-CN.md)

Build `11140102`.

### Added

- App Audio Library: replace notification sounds with custom audio. Apps not shown in the list can use the capture guide to obtain their notification-sound paths.
- Pairing & Device Connection: used to obtain required paths.

### Changed

- Case-insensitive cache UUID comparison (#131)
- Reject trailing text in date fields (#132)
- Share-inbox fallback (#133)
- Validate backup metadata filenames (#134)
- Reduce cache descriptor string-scan allocations (#135)
- Reuse one preview snapshot for field search (#136)
- Preserve field edits over layout presets (#137)
- Preserve existing plist keys when editing fields (#138)
- Reduce allocations in exact plist comparisons (#139)
- Traverse document differences once (#140)
- Fix Face ID failing after enabling Apple Intelligence (#128)
- Add missing localization for #128 (#146)
- Pairing paths are migrated when a reinstall moves the app data container.

### Fixed

- Fix pairing failure in side-loaded release builds.
- Add the missing Face ID recovery localization strings.
- Fix audio file selection in side-loaded builds.
- Refresh captured sounds immediately and cache the app audio list.
- Show LocalDevVPN guidance and stop capture when the tunnel does not connect.

detail.readme:
GestaltX

[![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-1.0.6-blue)](https://github.com/huamidev/GestaltX) [![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/iOS-27.x-black?logo=apple)](#compatibility) [![SwiftUI](https://img.shields.io/badge/Swift-SwiftUI-orange?logo=swift)](https://github.com/huamidev/GestaltX) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-GPLv3-blue)](LICENSE) [English](README.md) · [简体中文](README_ZH-CN.md) · [日本語](README_JA.md) A MobileGestalt editor for iPhone and iPad. Developed by [huamidev](https://github.com/huamidev). ## Features | Category | Presets and tools | | --- | --- | | Display | Dynamic Island capability and layout, Always-On Display, AOD Vibrancy, high-luminance AOD, AOD flipbook, HDR photo display, wallpaper parallax, Liquid Glass low-power rendering, experimental PWM and DisplayPort flags | | Device | Model name, boot/shutdown chime, charge limit, tap to wake, Camera Control settings, Action Button settings, Collision SOS, Audio Mix, Spatial FaceTime audio | | iPad | Apple Pencil settings, Stage Manager capability, iPad app compatibility | | Intelligence | Independent region-code options, Apple Intelligence capability flag, on-device Siri, Audio Intelligence, Personal Translator, Photos Clean Up, Handwriting Synthesis, always-listening Hey Siri, and sales-region options for activation attempts on China-mainland devices | | Advanced | Apple internal feature flags, the system-wide InternalBuild flag with explicit enable confirmation, internal settings bundle, Security Research Device flag | | Field editor | Read, search, add, edit, and remove `CacheExtra` fields; local plist import/export; String, Integer, Real, Boolean, Data, Date, Array, and Dictionary values | | Changes | Automatic reading and manual re-read, staged before/after review, verified writes, per-preset restore | | Backups | Automatic initial backup before device editing, backup before every write, original-value records; open, export, restore, and delete | | Logs & respring | Actual exploit-stage logs and manual NeoSpring respring | Usually, changing the region code is enough to try enabling AI; there is no need to change Sales Region. Selecting United States for Region Code sets `RegionCode` to `LL` and keeps the sales-region suffix. You can also choose China (Mainland), Hong Kong, Taiwan, Japan or the United Kingdom. Sales Region and Region Code can be applied together: the sales suffix follows Sales Region, while the code follows Region Code. *If you previously changed Sales Region, restore your device’s original sales region and apply it first.* Disabling a preset or using its Revert button restores the recorded original values and types. Keys that were originally absent are removed. If an older change has no original record, use Remove Added Fields only when you know those fields were added. Presets modify capability flags; actual effects depend on the device and OS. China-mainland devices can use the Apple Intelligence and region options to attempt activation; availability also depends on the model, OS version, and Apple services. ### Apple Intelligence, Face ID and dictation The [YumEdit 1.2.1 approach](https://github.com/H4CNPE/YumEdit/tree/v1.2.1) avoids spoofing the product, board and CPU. In Intelligence, **Apple Intelligence Capability** sets the generative-model flag to `1`, while the separate **Siri AI Mode** preset sets `SiriMode` to `2`. Neither changes hardware identity or the device-specific On-Device Siri capability. These are experimental flags, not a guarantee of resource downloads or working Apple Intelligence. YumEdit later replaced this activation approach with an experimental two-stage workflow; GestaltX does not implement temporary hardware spoofing. If a previous hardware spoof broke Face ID or dictation, choose an original device backup in **Backups → Restore Hardware Identity**. Alternatively, import a verified original plist and use **Intelligence → Restore Hardware Identity**. Save or discard pending changes first. Recovery requires a verified same-device backup with the same `CacheData`, `CacheUUID` and cache version, whose product and board match the kernel-reported hardware. It restores only product, board, CPU and the original regulatory model number, preserving current AI, Siri, region and unrelated settings. Unlike YumEdit's region activation, recovery does not substitute a US regulatory model. Missing, incompatible or already-spoofed backups are rejected; original hardware values are never guessed. Recovery currently recognizes iPhone 11 through iPhone 15/15 Plus (including the second- and third-generation SE), checking the original CPU against the known chip for the physical product. Other products are rejected rather than guessing their chip. A backup is created before writing and the complete result is verified. **Fully restart the device, then test Face ID, dictation and Apple Intelligence.** This recovery addresses hardware-spoofing damage, not every possible Face ID fault; device-level behavior still requires testing on affected hardware. ## Compatibility Supports **iOS / iPadOS 27.x**. **iOS / iPadOS 26.x is not supported for on-device MobileGestalt access.** Powered by [worse_query](https://github.com/forcequitOS/worse_query). SystemGroup access requires iOS 27; available features depend on the device and OS. Local plist editing is also supported. Signing requires a certificate and provisioning profile with at least one usable App Group. Sign the app and its embedded share extension with at least one **common App Group**, and keep the extension when re-signing. Both processes detect their actual signed App Groups at runtime. Distributed IPAs carry ad-hoc signatures with these entitlements embedded so SideStore and AltStore can detect them when re-signing; they are not signed with a developer certificate. ## Download Download the IPA from [Releases](https://github.com/huamidev/GestaltX/releases/latest). Some users report incomplete downloads with Safari on iOS 27. If the file is reported as damaged or cannot be extracted, download it again; several attempts may be needed. Try another browser if it persists. The cause has not been confirmed. ## Import a plist In Files or another app, select a MobileGestalt plist, tap **Share**, and choose **GestaltX**. The share extension reads the supplied file and hands it to the app through the shared App Group. Return to GestaltX if it does not open automatically. The app checks a device-bound proof from a GestaltX export, or at least two unique identifiers obtained from this device, then asks you to confirm the import. Files that cannot be verified are rejected. Previously imported files are never used as the reference for device identity. Some original plists contain no unique device identifiers. Export a copy from GestaltX on this device first: its verification key stays in the device-only Keychain and is never included in the file. Shared files are checked at launch and on return to the foreground. Pending edits are preserved until you save or discard them. Confirmed imports open as local documents. **MG Control** supports adding, editing, renaming and deleting typed keys and values. Use **Restore Imported Plist** to restore a verified file to this device; restoration requires a matching system cache layout and an additional confirmation, backs up the current file, and verifies the write. Restart the device afterward. ## Language support GestaltX follows your iOS language settings, with English as the default and fallback. Persian includes right-to-left layout support. | Language | Locale | | --- | --- | | English | `en` | | 简体中文 — Simplified Chinese | `zh-Hans` | | 繁體中文（台灣）— Traditional Chinese (Taiwan) | `zh-Hant-TW` | | 繁體中文（香港）— Traditional Chinese (Hong Kong) | `zh-Hant-HK` | | Tiếng Việt — Vietnamese | `vi` | | Русский — Russian | `ru` | | فارسی — Persian | `fa` | | 한국어 — Korean | `ko` | | Español — Spanish | `es` | | 日本語 — Japanese | `ja` | ## Credits - [forcequitOS / Taj C — worse_query](https://github.com/forcequitOS/worse_query) - [neonmodder123](https://github.com/neonmodder123) - [skadz108](https://github.com/skadz108) - [rooootdev — NeoSpring](https://github.com/rooootdev/neospring) - [Nouvborne — Ketamine](https://github.com/Nouvborne/Ketamine) - [PoomSmart — MGKeys](https://github.com/PoomSmart/MGKeys) - [leminlimez — Nugget](https://github.com/leminlimez/Nugget) - [rooootdev — mond](https://github.com/rooootdev/mond) - [frs0n — GestaltEdit](https://github.com/frs0n/GestaltEdit) ## Disclaimer For security research and educational purposes only. Use only on devices you own or are authorized to manage. Back up your data before making changes. Modifying MobileGestalt may cause system instability or require a device restore. You are responsible for the changes you apply and the resulting risks. ## License [GNU GPL v3](LICENSE) · Copyright © 2026 huamidev. ## Star History
